title: Brake Service Warranties Line Sheet: Vehicle Classes, Pad Compounds and Job Contents
content:
Six lines make up Brake Service Warranties, ranked from the Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty (rank 1) to the Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty (rank 6). Each line is sold for the vehicle classes listed against it, is fitted with its own pad compound, and includes in the job the services marked below.

| Brake service line | Eligible vehicle classes | Pad compound | Further entry requirement | Caliper slide pins cleaned and lubricated | Parking brake adjustment on rear jobs | Active warranties per axle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | passenger car; SUV or CUV; minivan | organic | none | No | No | 1 |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | passenger car; SUV or CUV; minivan; light truck | semi-metallic | none | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | passenger car; SUV or CUV; minivan; light truck | ceramic | none | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | passenger car; SUV or CUV; minivan; light truck | premium ceramic | vehicle in personal use | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | passenger car; SUV or CUV; minivan; light truck | premium ceramic | vehicle in personal use; new rotors required | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | light truck; commercial van; medium-duty truck; SUV or CUV | severe-duty semi-metallic | none | Yes | Yes | 1 |

**Column meanings.**
- *Eligible vehicle classes* — the vehicle classes the line is sold for.
- *Pad compound* — the pad material the line is fitted with.
- *Further entry requirement* — a requirement beyond the vehicle class: the two lifetime lines require a vehicle in personal use, and the Complete line also requires new rotors on the job.
- *Caliper slide pins cleaned and lubricated* — whether that caliper service is part of the job.
- *Parking brake adjustment on rear jobs* — whether a job on the rear axle includes a parking brake adjustment.
- *Active warranties per axle* — how many active brake warranties one axle of a vehicle may carry.

**Points read from the sheet.**
- A medium-duty truck or a commercial van appears only on the Severe-Duty line.
- A light truck appears on every line except the Value line.
- The Value line is the one line whose job includes neither the caliper slide pin service nor the parking brake adjustment.
- On every line, one axle carries at most 1 active warranty.
